semantics: cluster-to-cluster shortest path over the expanded portal graph, UNCAPPED entries/exits; intra-cluster snap legs are not modelled, so a same-cluster pair has no portal answer and the front uses the object anchor directly
units: weights in exact ms; cg_d* in exact metres over the same edges in the same order
edges: portal pf->pt = one CSR segment (length*1000/speed); interior ent[k]->ext[j] = exact interior ms / metres
caps: entries capped at 24 (the 1.88M-node unreached blob); exits uncapped
